title.en: An Act to Amend Section Three of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Four Hundred Eleven to Provide for the Construction of a Shop Building in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Three of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Four Hundred Eleven to Provide for the Construction of a Shop Building in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1457_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item fifty-one, roman numbered two, subsection aq. Quezon, section three of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred eleven, is hereby amended to read as follows:
51. Quezon Central School Shop Building—Construction ₱3,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
